verdict.rationale: Cekura's docs describe building custom dashboards with widgets over call data, metrics, and metadata (cekura-docs-11). Its custom Python and LLM-judge metrics supply the eval scores those dashboards can chart (cekura-docs-8, cekura-docs-9), and ingested calls feed metric evaluation and Observability (cekura-docs-25). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that latency, error-rate, and cost metrics are available as dashboard widgets, plus detail on widget types or queries and independent hands-on corroboration.
